title.purpose: Panel and dialog titles. The largest type in the app (~1rem); no hero scale above it.

body.purpose: Agent prose and the Whisper narrative timeline, Public Sans 14px, capped at 65-75ch.

heading.purpose: Mono small-caps section headings inside panels, used sparingly as structure.

label.purpose: Mono small-caps status labels and empty-state captions.

mono.purpose: Machine facts: SHAs, counts, timestamps, durations. Always tabular-nums for numerals.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Cool-ring focus affordance on inputs and buttons.

shadows.name: focus-ring-offset
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on dense adjacent controls where a flat ring would bleed into the neighbor.

shadows.name: amber-edge-glow
shadows.purpose: Single deliberate amber edge cue at a panel boundary. Not a card style.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Primary UI easing: wizard reveals, tile and nav entrances, question transitions.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Narrative timeline rows: thought, delta, and row-in settles.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Material-standard easing for infinite/looping states (loading shimmer, pulse).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action. Filament Amber fill, used once per surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; font-family: 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.98 0 0); background: oklch(0.72 0.17 75); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.625rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.72 0.17 75 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.62 0.19 264); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.62 0.19 264 / 0.5); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The toolbar default. Most buttons are ghost, not primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; font-family: 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.93 0 0); background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.625rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.22 0.005 260); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.62 0.19 264 / 0.5); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Slate-accent well, no heavy stroke; tone separates it from the panel.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; font-family: 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.93 0 0); background: oklch(0.24 0.005 260); border: 1px solid oklch(0.28 0.005 260); border-radius: 0.625rem; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.65 0.005 260); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.62 0.19 264); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.62 0.19 264 / 0.2); }

components.name: Status Dot
components.description: The smallest, most important component. Color is the entire status message; running pulses amber.
components.css: .ds-dot { display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-dot--running { background: oklch(0.72 0.17 75); animation: ds-dot-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite; } .ds-dot--idle { background: oklch(0.78 0.13 145); } .ds-dot--errored { background: oklch(0.78 0.13 25); } @keyframes ds-dot-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.35; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-dot--running { animation: none; } }

components.name: Sidebar Thread Row
components.description: The row the user scans first. Selection is a full row-fill, never a side-stripe. Indentation alone carries depth.
components.css: .ds-thread-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 1.75rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; color: oklch(0.93 0 0); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s; } .ds-thread-row:hover { background: oklch(0.22 0.005 260); } .ds-thread-row--selected { background: oklch(0.24 0.005 260); } .ds-thread-label { flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-family: 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-thread-meta { font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: oklch(0.65 0.005 260); }

components.name: Floating Panel
components.description: Lifted off the background by tone, not shadow. No resting drop shadow, no border by default.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 0.75rem; background: oklch(0.19 0.005 260); border-radius: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.93 0 0); } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.65 0.005 260); } .ds-panel-body { margin: 0; font-family: 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Empty State
components.description: A single glyph over a small-caps mono caption. No illustration, no hand-holding CTA.
components.css: .ds-empty { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 2rem; } .ds-empty-glyph { font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 28px; color: oklch(0.93 0 0 / 0.15); } .ds-empty-caption { font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.65rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.93 0 0 / 0.4); }

narrative.overview: Mcode is the surface a developer keeps open all evening on a second monitor while five agents run in parallel. It is not a destination; it is an instrument panel that sits next to the editor, the terminal, and the browser, built for the glance rather than the read. The register is editorial and typeset, closer to a code editor or terminal than a SaaS dashboard; density is a feature. Color is rationed: a warm amber primary on a matte cool-slate canvas, with sage for additions and clay for removals. Dark is the default canvas because the product is used in the evening; a warm light counterpart exists for daytime.
keyCharacteristics: Glance-first: status communicated by tinted dots and small monochrome glyphs, never paragraphs.
Dark-primary, warm-amber accent on cool-slate surfaces; light theme is the warm-neutral counterpart.
Tonal lift instead of divider lines: panels float a few percent off the page.
Monospace carries machine facts (SHAs, counts, timestamps, status labels); Public Sans carries human prose.
Keyboard-first: shortcuts are first-class, not hidden.
Information-dense by intent: tight, tabular, no decorative padding.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Filament Amber is the only brand color. It appears on a small fraction of any screen (the active row, the primary action, the live dot). Its rarity is what makes a glance land.

rules.name: The Semantic-Only Sage/Clay Rule
rules.body: Sage and clay are never decoration. They mean addition/good and removal/error.

rules.name: The Tinted-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Neutrals are never pure gray. Dark surfaces carry 0.005 chroma toward cool hue 260; light surfaces 0.005 toward warm hue 75.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Machine Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks machine-authored facts only. Counts and timestamps additionally take tabular-nums.

rules.name: The No-Hero Rule
rules.body: This is an app, not a landing page. Type tops out near 1rem; hierarchy comes from weight and mono/sans contrast, not size.

rules.name: The Tonal-Lift Rule
rules.body: Separation between surfaces is a step on the lightness ramp, not a line. A divider line is a failure of the tonal system.

rules.name: The Shadow-Is-State Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow appears only on focus or as a one-off boundary cue.

dos: Do ration Filament Amber. One accent, small footprint, reserved for the active row, the primary action, and live indicators.
Do carry separation with tonal lift; step a surface along the lightness ramp before adding a line.
Do set SHAs, counts, timestamps, and status labels in mono, with tabular-nums for any numerals.
Do use full row-fill (bg-accent) for selection, and indentation alone for tree depth.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion alternative, and reuse the existing wizard-* and narrative-* curves.
Do keep type capped near 1rem; build hierarchy from weight and mono/sans contrast.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on rows, cards, callouts, or alerts.
Don't add nested guide rails for tree indentation. Indentation alone.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text over a gradient). Solid colors only.
Don't use glassmorphism, decorative glow borders, or resting drop shadows on cards.
Don't introduce a second brand accent, or use green/red for anything other than added-or-good / removed-or-errored.
Don't soften copy into consumer language, add emoji decoration, or use colorful status chips where a tinted dot suffices.
Don't use raw Tailwind state colors (bg-yellow-500, bg-green-500). Use the tokenized diff/status colors.
Don't pad with marketing whitespace or build a hero-metric layout.
